problem.title: Top K Frequent Elements
problem.source: Official LeetCode problem page; original Chinese explanation and proof.
facts: Return the k most frequent elements.
The answer can be returned in any order.
The problem guarantees the answer is unique.

claims.claim: A size-k min-heap keeps the k largest frequencies among the values processed so far.
claims.validation: Inductive heap invariant and heap push/pop implementation.

claims.claim: Time O(n + u log k), auxiliary space O(u + k), where u is the number of distinct values.
claims.validation: Counter frequency scan and at most one push/pop pair per distinct value.
